units.source_text: 那天清晨，老师早早就到开园前的金阁附近散步。

en.t: That early morning, the teacher had gone out unusually early to stroll near the Golden Pavilion before the garden opened.

units.source_text: 在老师来说，这是罕见的事情。

en.t: For the teacher, this was a rare thing.

units.source_text: 老师还向正在打扫庭院的我们讲了几句慰劳的话。

en.t: The teacher also said a few words of appreciation to us as we were sweeping the garden.

units.source_text: 他身穿凉爽的白衣，登上了通向夕佳亭的石阶。

en.t: Dressed in cool white robes, he climbed the stone steps leading to Sekkatei.

units.source_text: 我想他大概要在这里独自品茶清心吧。

en.t: I thought he was probably going to sit there alone, savoring tea and clearing his mind.
